c01-luis-jacket.observed_description: Luis stands on a sidewalk in front of a light-brick building, seen from the knees up, smiling, in a long-sleeved black zip jacket with a collar over his navy T-shirt and khaki trousers.
c01-luis-jacket.note: Usable: the black jacket with sleeves to the wrists is the clear piece at 180 px; no red shirt, dress, hat or scarf. Face and build match the 1.2 reference.
